text: Program Description 1. Program Characteristics & Advantages Editor Notes: This program is the key specialty of Zhejiang Province. Software Engineering is a joint program with Bleking Institue of Technology (Sweden) and the key specialty of Zhejiang Province with the support of Zhejiang Provincial Key Disciplines of Computer Software & Theory and Internet of Things Engineering. We also build this specialty by leveraging the strengths from key disciplines of Computer System Architecture and Computer Application Technology of Zhejiang University of Technology, and Computer Network Engineering Research Center of Zhejiang University of Technology. We have a strong faculty team and high-quality experimental facilities, building three subjects including mobile software, embedded system and software outsourcing. We have formed the talent cultivation model with the characteristics of industry-education-research-application integration and refined classification of different cultivation targets. We aim at culturing engineering talents, mainly focusing on guiding students to set up a comprehensive and wide software engineering knowledge framework, strong engineering practice ability and innovative ability. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: Main courses include at least 12 courses. Chinese Language, Discrete Mathematics, Data Structure, C++ Programming, Java Programming, Principles of Computer Organization, Principles of Operating System, Principles of Computer Networks, Principles and Applications of Database, Web Application Development, Software Engineering, Human-Computer Interaction, Software Testing and Quality Assurance, Project Management. 3. Practice Base Editor Notes: After systematic study, students can choose to internshhip in nearly 70 software companies. We have established practice bases in nearly 70 well-known software corporations in China, and build four teaching and experimental bases in cooperation with Hangzhou National Animation Industry Base, Hangzhou National Digital Entertainment Industry Base and several famous companies of large-scale. We also collaborate with famous domestic and foreign universities and research institutes, including Chinese Academy of Sciences and Beijing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics. 4. Employment Information Editor Notes: Graduates are mainly engaged in hi-Tech corporation, public institutions, post and telecommunication departments and financial institutions. The graduates are mainly engaged in theory research, project research & development, application design and engineering management related to software field in new hi-Tech corporation, public institutions, post and telecommunication departments and financial institutions. 5. International Exchange Center (IEC) of ZJUT Editor Notes: CIE is responsible for study affairs and daily life service. International Exchange Center (IEC) of ZJUT is a special department in charge of recruitment, management and education for international students and students from Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan regions, providing: 1）Various Chinese language and culture learning programs 2）Various specialised programs in degree and non-degree studies 3）Arrangement for domestic and international academic conferences 4）Advanced educational facilities and comfortable daily life service 6. Zhejiang University of Technology Introduction Editor Notes: ZJUT is among the top 100 universities in P.R.China. ZJUT employs a high-level faculty and staffs of 2,800, with 800 professors and associate professors, and 4 are members in Chinese Academy of Science and Chinese Academy of Engineering. In recent five or six years over 250 achievements have won national, provincial or ministry awards for scientific innovation and research, among which 11 have won National Awards for Scientific and Technology Progress.
